node.title: EF descended-cycle inventory soundness
node.statement: If an inventory covers every B-defined pole-free horizontal cycle produced after full-orbit descent and labels each cycle with a verified base-descended, proper-subfield/tower-confined, or noncontainment-degenerate certificate, then ef_descended_cycle_classification_payload holds.
node.attack_surface: formal coverage and label-dispatch rule for EF descended-cycle inventories
node.falsifier: a complete valid descended-cycle inventory while the EF classification payload fails
